g.text: Two tetrahedra. One hidden face pair.
Print at 100%. Check the 50 mm bar before cutting.
Each net has four equilateral triangles. The joined solid has six exterior faces:
the two shaded base faces are internal. Tips meet three faces; belt vertices meet four.
Modern coordinate-based teaching sheet; not an ancient folding instruction.
Geometric dimensions verified in software; physical assembly and printing unverified.
